 S/o.Xavier,

 Judgment

The charge sheet has been filed in this case by the Police Sub Inspector of Malleswaram police station against the accused for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 341, 354(A)(D), 504,
506, 509 and 420 of IPC.
2.

In briefly the case of the prosecution is as follows:-
It is the case of the prosecution that, the C.W.2-Kum.Janani had enrolled C.C.3733/2019 herself for gym training into the Pebbles Gym run by the accused and accused got acquainted with C.W2, promised to love her and marry her.
When C.W.2 was in need of financial help the accused gave Rs.3,00,000/- to C.W2 and promised the CW.1 to marry C.W.2.

That one day in between 23.09.2018 and 05.10.2018, at Coffee day situated at Sampige road, the accused made sexual advances towards C.W.2 by touching her inappropriately and forced her for sexual acts and outraged her modesty.

Further on 23.09.2018 at about 10.25 P.M, at No.203, 1st floor,
B.K.Apartment, 8th cross, within the limits of Malleswaram PS, the accused abused K.Bhuvaneshwari vs Andro on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94309992/
1 CW.1 (mother of C.W.2) in filthy language and the accused abused and insulted C.W.2, criminally intimidated to the life of C.W1 and 2 for forcing C.W.2 to marry the accused.
Further, the accused cheated C.W.2 by promising to marry her and deceived her by refusing to marry C.W.2.
In this regard the C.W.1 lodged complaint against the accused before the Malleswaram Police seeking necessary action against the accused in accordance with law against him.
3. On the basis of the said complaint given by C.W.1, the complainant police have registered the case under Crime No.200/2018 and sent FIR to this Court and to their concerned higher authorities.

Thereafter, the complainant police have visited the spot and conducted the spot mahazar in the presence of the panch witnesses, herein after recorded the statements of witnesses who availed in the station subsequently who availed where the said mahazars have been drawn, after completion of the investigation the IO has arived at a conclusion that there are sufficient materials as to prosecute the accused, for which charge sheet has been filed for the above said offences.
4. After filing of the charge sheet, this Court registered the case is as numbered above, the accused appeared before court and was enlarged on bail.
Meanwhile copies of the charge sheet and other prosecution papers were duly supplied as required under Section 207 of Cr.P.C.

After hearing both sides, this court found that there were sufficient reasons so as to frame charge against the accused ,
therefore charge was framed for the offences punishable C.C.3733/2019 U/s. 354(A)(D), 504, 506,
509 and 420 of IPC and read over and explained to the accused in the language known to him, after understanding the same he denied the same and claimed to be tried, accordingly, proceeded with trial.
5. In order to prove its case, the prosecution has failed to examine the victim/complainant whose name is mentioned in the charge sheet.
Sufficient opportunity has been given to IO to secure the C.W.1 to 3.
The IO failed to secure the witnesses.
Learned A.P.P prayed for issuance of summons to CW1 to 3, inspite of giving sufficient opportunities to I.O. to execute summons, NBW, proclamation to the witnesses, even if have not been secured.
Hence, the evidence of CW1 to 3 dropped.

The C.W.
4 to 8 were given up as it would no purpose will be served if their evidence is recorded.
Consequently the statement of the accused as required Under Sec.313 of Cr.P.C was dispensed with.
6. Heard both side arguments, in compliance of section 437-A of Cr.P.C., bail bonds was obtained from the accused .

7. In view of above said facts and circumstances the following points that would arise for my consideration are as follows:-
POINTS FOR CONSIDERATION 1. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that the accused being acquainted with C.W2, promised to love her and marry her and the accused with a intention to commit an offence and in furtherance of that intention, one day in between 23.09.2018 and 05.10.2018, at Coffee day situated at Sampige road, the K.Bhuvaneshwari vs Andro on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94309992/
2 accused made sexual advances towards C.W.2 by touching her inappropriately and forced her for sexual acts and outraged her modesty and thereby the accused has committed an offence of "sexual harassment of the nature of unwelcome physical contact" punishable U/s 354A, 354D of IPC?

2. Whether the prosecution proves that the accused with a intention to commit an offence and in furtherance of that intention on 23.09.2018 at about 10.25 P.M, at No.203, 1st floor, B.K.Apartment, 8th C.C.3733/2019 cross, Malleswaram, the accused abused CW.1 (mother of C.W.2) in filthy language abused C.W1 in filthy language knowingly that it would give provocation to C.W.1 to breach public peace and thereby the accused has committed an offence of "intentional insult" punishable under section 504 of IPC?

3. Whether the prosecution proves that the accused with a intention to commit an offence and in furtherance of that intention on the above mentioned date, time and place and accused abused and insulted C.W.2 thereby the accused committed the offence of "word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman"
punishable U/s 509 of IPC?
4.Whether the prosecution proves that the accused with a intention to commit an offence and in furtherance of that intention on the above mentioned date, time and place the accused criminally intimidated to the life of C.W1 and 2 for forcing C.W.2 to marry the accused and thereby the accused has committed an offence of "criminal intimidation"
punishable under section 506 of IPC?
5.

Whether the prosecution proves that on the above mentioned date, time and place the accused with an intention to commit an offence and in furtherance of his intention accused cheated C.W.2 by promising to marry her and deceived her by refusing to marry C.W.2 and thereby the accused has committed an offence of "cheating" punishable under section 420 of IPC?
6. What Order?
8. My answers to the above points are as under:
Point Nos.1 to 5 : In the 'Negative' Point No.6 : As per the final order, for the following:-
REASONS 9. Point No.1 to 5: As these points are interlinked with each other I have taken all these points together for common discussion in order to avoid repetition of facts and discussion.

3 10. It is the allegation that the accused has committed the offences C.C.3733/2019 punishable u/s.
341, 354(A)(D), 504, 506, 509 and 420 of IPC.

sentences.text: In support of prosecution case after framing of charge, being issued summons to C.W.1 to 3, who are said to be complainant, victim and mahazar witnesss, even they could not be secured before the court.
Finally proclamation has been issued and the witnesses could not be secured as a result of which the examination of C.W.1 to 3 is ordered to be dropped.

The Learned PP prayed that this court may issue summons to remaining witnesses ie C.W.4 to 8, based on the submission made by the Learned P.P and on perusal of the documents it depicts that here the offences are not against the State or any other property of the State so as to record evidence of remaining charge sheet witnesses.

In fact it exclusively affects the individual/C.W.1 and 2 even if the prosecution failed to secure C.W.1 and 2 before court, as such by recording evidence of remaining witnesses no purpose will be served, except waste of precious time of this Court, as such after considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the prayer of Learned PP has been rejected by mentioning the above said reasons.
Therefore this court is of the considered view that the prosecution has failed to establish its case by producing and adducing reliable evidence.
Hence, I answer point no.1 to 5 in the Negative.
11. Point No.6:

In view of my findings on point Nos.1 to 5 and reasons assigned therein, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER Acting under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., the accused is not found guilty and he is hereby acquitted of the offences punishable under Secs. 354(A)(D), 504, 506,
509 and 420 of IPC.
The bail bond bonds executed by the accused stands cancelled.

In compliance of section 437-A of Cr.P.C. the bail bond executed by the accused is ordered to be continued in force for six months or till issuance of C.C.3733/2019 notice in respect of any appeal [if preferred] against the present Judgment before the Appellate Court.
(Judgment typed to my online dictation by the Stenographer, computerized copy revised, corrected and signed & then pronounced in the Open court on this the 12th day of December, 2024.)
(KESHAVA.K) XXXII Addl.
Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bengaluru.
